alertsWritten.instrument: ICO final Storage and Access Technologies guidance — three new PECR DUAA exemptions (Statistical, Appearance, Emergency); simple means of objecting requirement
alertsWritten.reasonForAlert: Binding DPA guidance (Trigger #4) finalising the three new PECR cookie exemptions introduced by DUAA. Requires new UK-specific jurisdiction routing and banner opt-out controls (not a consent gate) for Statistical and Appearance categories. Previously in scan gap; first coverage.

alertsWritten.instrument: CNIL Recommendation No. 2026-042 — email tracking pixels under Article 82 French Data Protection Act; prior consent required; transition deadline 2026-07-14
alertsWritten.reasonForAlert: Binding CNIL recommendation (Trigger #4) extending cookie consent rule to email pixels; active transition deadline 39 days out (2026-07-14). Requires new email_tracking_pixels purpose in consent taxonomy, transition notification flow, and consent-at-collection workflow. First coverage.

alertsWritten.instrument: IAB Europe TCF Policy v5.0.b — standardTexts UI requirement, multi-device consent propagation, LI-bit workaround removal; CMP web deadline mid-October 2026
alertsWritten.reasonForAlert: Industry framework update (Trigger #8) requiring CMP code changes. Three distinct obligations: standardTexts rendering in banner, multi-device TC string propagation, removal of legacy LI-bit workaround. GVL update mid-July 2026; CMP web deadline mid-October 2026. First coverage.

alertsWritten.instrument: CPPA Stipulated Final Order — PlayOn Sports, USD 1.1M fine for cookie banner lacking opt-out parity and NAI/DAA redirect insufficiency as sole opt-out mechanism
alertsWritten.reasonForAlert: Precedent-setting enforcement action (Trigger #5) directly sanctioning a specific cookie banner pattern (no equivalent opt-out/reject) and confirming NAI/DAA redirects are insufficient CCPA opt-out mechanisms. Requires banner configurator validation rule and tenant audit. Fell in scan gap before first daily scan; first coverage.

candidatesConsideredButRejected.item: California AG / CPPA Disney/ABC settlement (2026-02-11, USD 2.75M)
candidatesConsideredButRejected.rejectionReason: pre-window and partially-out-of-scope — primarily addresses opt-out linkage across authenticated accounts and cross-service opt-out chaining, not cookie banner design. The finding (opt-out must apply across logged-in account services) is incremental to existing multi-property consent guidance and does not create a new engineering obligation beyond what PlayOn Sports RW-2026-06-05-04 already covers. Recommended for weekly digest.
